description:
Top-level comments of a YouTube video by URL or ID, sorted by top or newest: text, author, likes, reply count, pinned and hearted flags, plus the total comment count.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id`.
Returns: video_id (string), sort (string), comment_count (integer, nullable), comments_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean), comments (array<object>).

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return. Example: 20

sort.description: top or newest. Default top. Example: "newest"

url.description: YouTube video URL (watch, youtu.be, shorts, live or embed link; a bare ID also works). Example: "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ"

name: youtube_comments
title: YouTube comments
